purpose: A car insurance quote without the forty-question form.

requests.ask: Which car is this quote for? It might not be yours.
requests.why: Starts the quote on the right vehicle. We ask, we don't assume.

requests.ask: Roughly how far is it driven in a year?
requests.why: One of the biggest inputs to your price.

requests.ask: Who else drives it? Just how many and their rough ages, no names.
requests.why: Named drivers change the price. Names come later, on the form, if you proceed.

requests.ask: Any claims or convictions in the last five years?
requests.why: Required by every insurer. We ask you directly and never guess.

requests.ask: Your date of birth, for the quote only.
requests.why: Age is a rating factor. Held for this session, not saved.

offers.what: Renewal date, cover level, excess, what's included.
offers.why: Your assistant can warn you a month before renewal and compare like for like.

ext.notes: Deliberately session-only throughout. The two protected requests illustrate: (a) the site must show the why; (b) the agent must not answer from memory even if it knows the user's date of birth; (c) the manifest never asks for licence numbers, registration plates or names, which belong on the authenticated form, not in a manifest.
